en.title: Vertical Aerospace Secures $100M Financing Commitments for Valo eVTOL Certification
en.summary: Vertical Aerospace has secured $100 million in financing commitments to advance its Valo eVTOL certification and commercialisation.
body: Vertical Aerospace has announced financing commitments of approximately $100 million to advance its Valo electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft towards certification and commercialisation. The funding package includes $40 million from Mudrick Capital Management, $35 million from an underwritten equity offering, and $25 million from a Yorkville Advisors Global facility.

The company stated that the capital will support Critical Design Review, production preparations, expanded battery manufacturing, and hybrid-electric flight testing. Vertical Aerospace plans to retrofit its third prototype aircraft for hybrid-electric testing in the first half of 2027, with certification flight testing expected in 2028 and entry into service targeted for 2029.
Vertical Aerospace cautioned that the Mudrick component remains subject to definitive agreements and may not be completed on current terms or at all.

en.title: British Airways Airbus A380 Returns After 7-Hour Flight Due To Radar Failure
en.summary: British Airways Airbus A380 returned after a seven-hour flight following a weather radar failure.
body: According to Simple Flying, a British Airways Airbus A380 superjumbo was forced to execute an in-flight turnaround after experiencing a complete weather radar failure during flight operations.
The aircraft's onboard weather radar system failed while en route, leaving the aircraft without functioning weather radar capabilities necessary for detecting atmospheric hazards along the route.

As a direct result of the weather radar system malfunction during the flight, the British Airways Airbus A380 turned back toward its original departure point. The superjumbo aircraft ultimately completed a seven-hour flight to nowhere before returning and landing back at its origin.

en.title: Archer to Acquire Wisk, Insitu and SkyGrid as Boeing Takes 19.75% Stake
en.summary: Archer agrees to buy three Boeing units; Boeing receives 19.75% stake and $200M warrants
body: Aerospace Global News reports that Archer Aviation has agreed to acquire Boeing subsidiaries Wisk Aero, Insitu and SkyGrid.
Upon closing, Boeing will receive Archer shares representing 19.75% of the company's outstanding Class A stock and the right to appoint one director to Archer's board.
Boeing will also receive two warrants allowing it to purchase up to $200 million in additional Archer stock later.
The transaction remains subject to various conditions, including U.S. competition‑law regulatory requirements, and is expected to complete by the end of 2026.
The deal brings together Wisk's autonomous passenger eVTOL, Insitu's combat‑proven uncrewed aircraft business, and SkyGrid's digital airspace management technology under Archer.

zh.summary: 直升機在野火滅火任務中墜毀；兩名飛行員確認死亡
body: 兩名飛行員在8月7日於犹他州中央地區執行野火滅火任務時，所駕駛的Sikorsky S-64 Skycrane直升機墜毀。
直升機於當地時間約10:40在Richfield附近的Widemouth 2 Fire上空降落水時失事，機上僅有兩人，皆為機組人員。
該機由Helicopter Transport Services操作，受美國森林服務局合約執行滅火任務。
事故後 steep 地形與活動中的野火阻礙救援人員即時到場，次日人員抵達 wreckage 並確認兩名飛行員已死亡，遺體已送至犹他州驗屍官辦公室。
全美運輸安全委員會（NTSB）調查員於7月8日抵達犹他州，但由於野火狀況尚未能到達 wreckage 進行現場勘查。

en.title: Two Pilots Killed as Sikorsky S-64 Skycrane Crashes During Utah Wildfire Water Drop
en.summary: Helicopter crashes during wildfire firefighting in Utah; two pilots confirmed dead
body: Two pilots were killed when a Sikorsky S-64 Skycrane crashed while dropping water on a wildfire in central Utah on August 7, 2026.
The accident occurred at approximately 10:40 local time while the helicopter was supporting crews battling the Widemouth 2 Fire near Richfield, Utah.
The S-64 was operated by Helicopter Transport Services under a contract with the US Forest Service, with only the two crew members aboard.

Steep terrain and the active wildfire initially prevented emergency responders from reaching the wreckage; crews arrived the next day and confirmed both pilots had been killed, with remains taken to the Utah Office of the Medical Examiner.
National Transportation Safety Board investigators arrived in Utah on July 8 but have been unable to reach the crash site due to ongoing wildfire conditions.

zh.title: 莱茵金属在德国建立波音MQ-28幽灵蝙蝠整合能力
zh.summary: 莱茵金属宣布在德建立MQ-28整合能力；德国空军CCA竞标加速
body: 莱茵金属于2026年8月10日宣布，在德国建立波音MQ-28幽灵蝙蝠的独立系统整合能力，这是波音主导团队争取德国空军协同作战飞机（CCA）需求的首个具体工业承诺。
该杜塞尔多夫集团自2026年3月31日双方宣布合作以来，一直担任波音在德国的系统整合合作伙伴。
莱茵金属表示，德产MQ-28的软件开发、任务整合及知识产权将留在德国工业基础内，国家传感器、武器与任务软件将在国内整合。莱茵金属空中、无人与航天业务单元CEO迈克·施密特称：“德国不必在速度与独立之间二选一。”
波音MQ-28项目全球总监格伦·弗格森指出，为实现2029年投入使用目标，战术、训练、部队架构及主权技术整合工作必须立即启动。MQ-28已于2025年12月发射AIM-120 AMRAAM击中靶机，2026年6月1日完成雷达散射截面测试，并于2026年6月参加“勇敢盾牌”演习，与美军F-15EX等协同作战。
德国工业团队现包括莱茵金属、罗德与施瓦茨、迪尔防务及汉索特，四公司已于2026年7月在范堡罗航展与波音签署谅解备忘录。德国空军需求估计达400架，交付自2029年起；联邦议院预算委员会于7月8日批准超过95亿欧元的国防拨款。竞争对手包括空客与克雷托斯的XQ-58A、亨泽尔的CA-1欧洲版、通用原子的YFQ-42A衍生型，莱茵金属亦保留与安德鲁尔的YFQ-44A合作。

en.title: Rheinmetall Establishes Boeing MQ-28 Ghost Bat Integration Capability in Germany
en.summary: Rheinmetall sets up MQ-28 integration in Germany; German Air Force CCA competition accelerates
body: Rheinmetall announced on 10 August 2026 that it is establishing an independent system integration capability for the Boeing MQ-28 Ghost Bat in Germany, marking the first concrete industrial commitment from the Boeing-led team competing for the German Air Force’s collaborative combat aircraft (CCA) requirement.
The Düsseldorf-based group has served as Boeing’s German system integration partner since the two companies announced their partnership on 31 March 2026.

Rheinmetall said software development, mission integration and intellectual property for a German version of the MQ-28 would remain within the country’s industrial base, with national sensors, weapons and mission software integrated domestically. “Germany does not have to choose between speed and independence,” said Mike Schmidt, CEO of Rheinmetall’s Air, Uncrewed and Space business unit.

Boeing’s MQ-28 programme director Glen Ferguson stated that meeting a 2029 in-service target requires immediate work on tactics, training, force structure and sovereign technology integration. The platform’s flight-test record includes an AIM-120 AMRAAM launch against a target drone in December 2025, radar cross-section testing announced on 1 June 2026, and participation in Exercise Valiant Shield in June 2026 alongside US Air Force F-15EX fighters.

The German industrial team now includes Rheinmetall, Rohde & Schwarz, Diehl Defence and HENSOLDT, which signed a memorandum of understanding with Boeing at the Farnborough International Airshow in July 2026. The German Air Force requirement is estimated at up to 400 aircraft with deliveries beginning in 2029 under the Combat Fighter System Nucleus (CFSN) programme. The Bundestag budget committee cleared funding for CFSN on 8 July 2026 as part of a defence package worth more than €9.5 billion. Competing offers include Airbus and Kratos with the Europeanised XQ-58A Valkyrie, Helsing with the CA-1 Europa, and General Atomics with a derivative of the YFQ-42A; Rheinmetall also retains a separate partnership with Anduril Industries for a European version of the YFQ-44A Fury.

zh.summary: 西南航空飛往洛杉磯航班一名二十二歲乘客於機上突發疾病身亡。
body: 據《Simple Flying》報導，西南航空一架飛往洛杉磯的航班在飛行途中發生醫療緊急狀況。一名二十二歲的乘客在航班飛行途中突發疾病，經搶救後於機上不幸身亡。
報導指出，在該名乘客於空中出現醫療症狀後，現場人員曾對其實施多次心肺復甦術（CPR）嘗試進行搶救。不過，急救嘗試未能順利救回，該名乘客最終在航班飛行途中身亡。
此次突發醫療事件發生於飛往洛杉磯的西南航空航班上，該名二十二歲乘客於機上不幸身亡。

en.title: Southwest Airlines Passenger Dies Mid-Flight on Los Angeles Route
en.summary: Southwest Airlines passenger dies after medical episode on flight to Los Angeles despite CPR.
body: A 22-year-old passenger died after suffering a medical episode mid-flight on a Southwest Airlines service bound for Los Angeles, according to a report by Simple Flying. The medical emergency occurred during the flight while the aircraft was en route to its destination.

Following the onset of the medical emergency in the air, multiple CPR attempts were made on board the flight in an effort to save the passenger. Resuscitation efforts were carried out mid-flight after the individual experienced the health episode.
Despite the multiple CPR attempts performed during the flight, the 22-year-old passenger could not be revived and died during the trip to Los Angeles.

en.title: Vertical Aerospace Secures $100 Million Funding for Valo eVTOL Program
en.summary: Vertical Aerospace secured $100 million in funding commitments to advance its Valo eVTOL certification and commercialization.
body: Vertical Aerospace announced on August 10, 2026, that it has secured $100 million in funding commitments from existing and new investors. The fresh funds will support the company's next steps toward certification and commercialization of its Valo eVTOL aircraft, including the upcoming Critical Design Review.

The financing round includes $40 million from existing investor Mudrick Capital Management, under a non-binding agreement in principle. An additional $35 million will be underwritten by existing and new investors, while $25 million will be drawn from a preferred equity facility established by Yorkville Advisors Global.
The funds will also support expanding Vertical Aerospace's Energy Centre for battery production and establishing future large-scale manufacturing facilities in the UK.

zh.title: 印度航空高度驟降機長初篩毒陽性需複檢
zh.summary: 機師初篩毒陽性；印度航空複檢進行；空中巴士協助調查
body: 路透社報導，印度航空一名機長在飛行中出現高度驟降後，初步毒品檢測呈陽性，航空公司因而要求進行進一步複檢。
同一天，空中巴士發表聲明，將協助印度航空進行此次高度異常事件的調查。
目前尚未有官方指出事故原因或是否導致人員受傷，調查仍在進行中。
根據航空安全規定，任何機師在飛行中出現異常狀態均需接受毒品與酒精測試。
印度航空表示將全力配合調查，並依照內部程序處理此事。
空中巴士強調其角色僅為技術支援，不參與事故原因的最終判定。
事件發生的具體航班號、機型及時間細節在報導中未被披露。

en.title: Air India captain's initial drug test positive after sudden altitude loss, further screening ordered
en.summary: Pilot initial drug screen positive; Air India orders retest; Airbus to assist investigation
body: Reuters reported that an Air India captain underwent a drug screening after a sudden loss of altitude during a flight, and the initial test returned positive for substances, prompting the airline to require further testing.
On the same day, Airbus issued a statement saying it will assist Air India in investigating the altitude loss incident.
No official cause has been determined, and there is no confirmation of injuries or damage; the investigation remains ongoing.
Under aviation safety regulations, any flight crew member showing abnormal inflight status must undergo drug and alcohol testing.
Air India said it will fully cooperate with the investigation and follow its internal procedures.
Airbus emphasized its role is limited to technical assistance and it will not participate in the final determination of accident causes.
Details such as flight number, aircraft type, and exact timing of the incident were not disclosed in the reports.

zh.summary: S7 波音737-800 貨機 挪利斯克 跑道 外滑，再無人員受傷
body: S7 Airlines 波音737-800 貨機 在 2026 年 8 月 8 日降落時跑出 挪利斯克 阿利克機場 （NSK） 跑道末端。
機上有兩名機組人員及貨物，事件中無人員受傷，機體僅受輕微損傷。
俄羅斯西西伯利亞運輸檢察署已介入調查，諾西бир斯克運輸檢察署正檢查航空公司是否符合安全要求，並努力釐清事件發生的具體情況。
這是 S7 Airlines 在短短六週內第二次 波音737-800 跑道外滑事件，前一次發生於 2026 年 6 月 30 日在 萊納 州米爾尼 機場（MJZ）。
先前事故中的客機 編號 RA-73359，執行 S7 航班 5241，載有 173 名乘客與六名機組人員，亦未造成人員傷亡。

en.title: S7 Airlines Boeing 737-800 freighter overruns runway at Norilsk airport
en.summary: S7 Airlines 737-800 freighter overruns Norilsk runway; no injuries reported
body: An S7 Airlines Boeing 737-800 freighter overran the runway while landing at Norilsk Alykel Airport (NSK) on August 8, 2026.
The aircraft carried two crew members and cargo; no injuries were reported and the plane suffered only minor damage.

Russian authorities have opened investigations, with the West Siberian Transport Prosecutor’s Office examining compliance with aviation safety requirements and investigators working to determine the circumstances.
This is the second Boeing 737-800 runway overrun for S7 Airlines in less than six weeks; the earlier event occurred on June 30, 2026 at Mirny Airport (MJZ) in the Sakha Republic.
The previous overrun involved aircraft registration RA-73359 operating as S7 Flight 5241 from Novosibirsk Tolmachevo (OVB) to Mirny, carrying 173 passengers and six crew, with no injuries reported.

en.title: Starlux Airlines and Tigerair Taiwan Report Strong July Revenues and Fleet Developments
en.summary: Starlux Airlines and Tigerair Taiwan reported substantial revenue growth in July, supported by high summer travel demand.
body: Starlux Airlines reported a July revenue of NTD 5.729 billion, representing an 8% monthly increase and a 43% year-on-year growth. The airline's cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NTD 34.282 billion, up 32%. In fleet and route updates, Starlux launched its Taipei-Prague service on August 1 and plans to upgrade the flight equipment to Airbus A350-1000 in September.

Tigerair Taiwan generated NTD 1.77 billion in July revenue, a 27% increase year-on-year, achieving an average passenger load factor of 92%. To support its network expansion, the carrier signed a memorandum of understanding with Pratt & Whitney's IAE to cooperate on engine procurement and maintenance for its third-generation Airbus A321neo fleet, which will be introduced starting in 2028.

zh.title: 星宇航空與台灣虎航公布7月營收受惠暑期旺季大幅成長
zh.summary: 星宇航空與台灣虎航7月營收顯著成長；暑期旅遊熱絡帶動客運表現
body: 受惠於暑期旅遊旺季表現暢旺，星宇航空與台灣虎航於2026年8月10日公布7月營收數據，雙雙寫下顯著成長成績。星宇航空7月單月營收達到新台幣57.29億元，月增8%、年增43%；今年前7個月累計營收則為342.82億元，較去年同期成長32%。
在星宇航空營收結構中，7月客運營收為新台幣45.08億元，月增11%、年增42%，顯示夏季暑期旺季客運市場需求相當強勁。貨運方面，7月貨運營收為6.84億元，年增43%，主要受惠於人工智慧（AI）與雲端基礎設施投資動能持續，帶動高價值電子相關產品需求維持高檔。
機隊與航網規劃方面，星宇航空於7月完成首架「空山銀」彩繪機交付，預計8月加入第2架「空山金」彩繪機以擴充運能。此外，星宇航空自8月1日起正式開航台北往返布拉格航線，初期以A350-900機型執飛每週3班，預計9月升級為A350-1000機型，並規劃於10月1日起增加為每週4班。
台灣虎航方面，7月自結單月營收達到17.7億元，年增27%，創下歷史同期新高，平均載客率達到92%。今年前7個月累計營收為120.95億元，年增23%，累計航班數較去年同期增加12%，平均載客率達91%新高。台灣虎航對年底前的客運需求保持樂觀，並已與普惠（Pratt & Whitney）旗下IAE公司簽署合作備忘錄，針對2028年起引進之第3代A321neo機隊進行發動機採購與維護合作。

en.title: Starlux Airlines and Tigerair Taiwan Report Strong July Revenue Growth
en.summary: Starlux Airlines and Tigerair Taiwan reported strong July revenue growth driven by summer travel demand.
body: Starlux Airlines and Tigerair Taiwan reported strong financial results for July 2026, driven by robust demand during the summer travel peak. Starlux Airlines posted monthly revenue of NT$5.729 billion for July, representing an 8 percent increase month-on-month and a 43 percent expansion year-on-year. Over the first seven months of 2026, the carrier accumulated revenue of NT$34.282 billion, up 32 percent compared to the same period last year.

Detailed figures from Starlux Airlines show that passenger revenue reached NT$4.508 billion in July, growing 11 percent month-on-month and 42 percent year-on-year. Cargo revenue climbed 43 percent year-on-year to NT$684 million. The airline attributed cargo growth to ongoing investment in artificial intelligence and cloud infrastructure, which supported high demand for high-value electronic components.

Regarding fleet updates and network expansion, Starlux Airlines took delivery of its first "Kongshan Silver" special livery aircraft in July, with a second "Kongshan Gold" aircraft scheduled to join the fleet in August. On August 1, Starlux launched its flight service between Taipei and Prague. The route initially operates three weekly flights using Airbus A350-900 aircraft, with plans to upgrade to the larger A350-1000 in September and increase frequency to four weekly flights from October 1.

Meanwhile, Tigerair Taiwan recorded July revenue of NT$1.77 billion, marking a 27 percent year-on-year increase and setting a record for the month, supported by an average load factor of 92 percent. For the first seven months of 2026, Tigerair Taiwan achieved cumulative revenue of NT$12.095 billion, up 23 percent year-on-year, with total flights rising 12 percent and average load factor reaching 91 percent. To support long-term fleet growth, Tigerair Taiwan signed a memorandum of understanding with IAE, a subsidiary of Pratt & Whitney, for engine procurement and maintenance covering its third-generation Airbus A321neo fleet delivered from 2028.

en.title: Vertical Aerospace Secures $100 Million to Advance Valo eVTOL Development
en.summary: Vertical Aerospace raises $100M for Valo eVTOL certification and production
body: Vertical Aerospace announced on 10 August 2026 that it has secured US$100 million in funding commitments from existing and new investors to advance the Valo eVTOL programme.

The round comprises three tranches: US$40 million from Mudrick Capital Management, including a US$5 million draw and a US$35 million accelerated draw by 12 August; US$35 million underwritten by a group of investors at US$1.05 per unit; and US$25 million from a preferred‑equity facility of Yorkville Advisors Global.

Proceeds will fund the upcoming Critical Design Review, expansion of the Energy Centre for battery production, and establishment of large‑scale UK production facilities, which may receive a £10 million UK government contribution.

body: Archer Aviation與波音於2026年8月10日簽署確定協議，Archer將收購波音旗下的Wisk Aero、SkyGrid與Insitu等子公司，組合雙方在自主飛行、電動垂直起降（eVTOL）飛機與無人航空載具系統（UAS）領域的技術能力。

en.title: Archer to Acquire Boeing Subsidiaries Wisk, SkyGrid and Insitu as Boeing Takes Stake
en.summary: Archer Aviation will acquire Boeing subsidiaries Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and Insitu, with Boeing acquiring an Archer stake.
body: Archer Aviation and The Boeing Company announced on August 10, 2026, that they have signed definitive agreements for Archer to acquire Boeing's Wisk Aero, SkyGrid, and Insitu subsidiaries. The agreement combines capabilities in autonomy, electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft, and unmanned aircraft systems into an end-to-end platform.

In conjunction with the deal, Boeing will take a stake in Archer and become a strategic partner. Boeing and Archer are also entering into a technology-sharing arrangement through which Boeing retains ongoing access to Wisk's core autonomous flight technology for current and future aerospace programs.

zh.title: 美國空軍確認B-21轟炸機將於2027年服役
zh.summary: 美空軍重申B-21預計2027年服役；B-1B退役時間延至2037年
body: 美國空軍於2026年8月10日重申，B-21「突襲者」（Raider）戰略隱形轟炸機研發進度符合預期，仍將按原定計畫於2027年正式進入現役。五角大廈關鍵主要武器系統主管戴爾·懷特將軍（General Dale White）在俄亥俄州代頓市舉行的生命週期工業日（Life Cycle Industry Days）上發表演說，證實B-21轟炸機將於2027年進駐南達科他州的埃爾斯沃思空軍基地（Ellsworth Air Force Base）。懷特將軍指出，該計畫目前持續達成各項飛行測試里程碑，並毫不猶豫地重申其2027年的服役時程。
除了B-21轟炸機的服役時間表外，美空軍同時決定將現役B-1B「槍騎兵」（Lancer）轟炸機的退役時間延後至2037年左右。這項決定顯示，在B-21轟炸機成熟並能達到大規模量產與部署之前，空軍需要繼續維持現有戰略轟炸機隊的作戰能力。美空軍官員補充說明，B-21計畫在2026財政年度獲得額外47億美元的資金注入，並已成功將B-21的工業生產產能提升25%。
根據相關預算規劃，B-21計畫在2027財政年度的總預算需求約為61億美元，其中約29億美元分配給研究、開發、測試與評估（RDT&E），另外約32億美元則用於長前置期項目的採購。此一預算規模與先前獲得45億美元一次性補充資金以加速生產並維持計畫進度的特別撥款相呼應。測試進度方面，空軍採取聯合開發與作戰測試模式，將原定180天的測試里程碑縮短至73天完成。
此外，美國眾議院已通過的《國防授權法案》（NDAA）報告中對現行採購計畫提出關切，認為自2015年建立的100架B-21採購目標在當前安全環境下可能不足以滿足國家防衛戰略需求。該法案已指示國防部長須於2026年12月前提交評估報告，重新審視並確定未來所需的B-21轟炸機總量及可能追加的採購需求。

en.title: US Air Force Reaffirms B-21 Raider Stealth Bomber Service Entry for 2027
en.summary: US Air Force confirms B-21 Raider will enter service in 2027; B-1B retirement delayed to 2037.
body: The United States Air Force has reaffirmed that the Northrop Grumman B-21 Raider strategic stealth bomber remains on schedule and will officially enter service in 2027. Speaking at the Life Cycle Industry Days in Dayton, Ohio, US Air Force General Dale White, director of Critical Major Weapon Systems at the Pentagon, stated that B-21 Raiders will be on the ramp at Ellsworth Air Force Base in 2027. General White highlighted that the aircraft continues to achieve flight milestones, confirming the 2027 service timeline without hesitation.

Separately, the Air Force is delaying the scheduled retirement of its B-1B Lancer bomber fleet to around 2037, suggesting that additional time is required for the B-21 to mature and become available in significant operational numbers. To support production acceleration, the B-21 program received an additional $4.7 billion in fiscal year 2026 funding, allowing the Air Force to expand its B-21 industrial capacity by 25 percent.

The total budget request for the B-21 in Fiscal Year 2027 stands at approximately $6.1 billion. This funding request is divided into roughly $2.9 billion for Research, Development, Test and Evaluation (RDT&E) and $3.2 billion in procurement for advance items. The Air Force has also compressed testing timelines, completing a planned 180-day test campaign in just 73 days through combined developmental and operational flight testing.

Meanwhile, the House National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) includes a requirement addressing the program of record. Expressing concern that the baseline requirement of 100 aircraft established in 2015 may be insufficient for current strategic demands, Congress has directed the Secretary of Defense to submit an assessment report by December 2026 to evaluate total B-21 fleet requirements and potential additional orders.

body: 英國旗艦航空公司英國航空已選擇普惠公司的齒輪傳動風扇（GTF）發動機，為其多達63架空中巴士A320neo系列客機提供動力。這項決定標誌著英國航空首次在其A320neo系列客機機隊中引進第二家發動機供應商。

en.title: British Airways Selects Pratt & Whitney GTF Engines for 63 A320neo Aircraft
en.summary: British Airways selects Pratt & Whitney GTF engines to power up to 63 Airbus A320neo family aircraft.
body: British Airways, the primary flag carrier of the United Kingdom, has selected Pratt & Whitney's geared turbofan (GTF) engines to power up to 63 Airbus A320neo family aircraft. This decision marks the first time that British Airways is introducing a second engine supplier for its Airbus A320neo family fleet.

The selection officially ends decades of exclusive reliance on CFM International engines for the UK carrier's Airbus narrowbody fleet. By choosing Pratt & Whitney GTF powerplants for its latest A320neo aircraft, British Airways breaks with long-standing precedent and establishes a multi-supplier approach for its narrowbody operations.

zh.title: 長榮航班下機爆旅客糾紛 航警釐清是否涉違反民航法
zh.summary: 醫師搭乘長榮航班遭刮傷；航警局主動聯繫當事人；將釐清是否涉違反民航法。
body: 醫師鄭丞傑於2026年8月9日搭乘長榮航空班機抵達桃園國際機場，在下機時遭一名往前衝撞的旅客刮傷手臂。鄭丞傑隨後透過社群網站臉書發文表示，當時在現場等待近半小時仍未見警察上機處置。
內政部警政署航空警察局於8月10日說明，接獲航空公司通報班機發生旅客糾紛時，警力正處理其他旅客拒登機事件。當員警隨後抵達班機停靠的第3航廈D16登機門時，現場旅客均已下機。航空公司人員隨後協助將相關旅客帶往航警局勤務處所瞭解狀況。
航警局表示已於10日主動聯繫當事醫師，當事人指出不願提出告訴。警方針對是否涉及違反民用航空法部分，將於釐清案情後依法偵處，並將持續檢視勤務運作與跨單位聯繫機制，以提升突發事件應變能力。

en.title: Aviation Police Investigate Passenger Dispute on EVA Air Flight at Taoyuan Airport
en.summary: Aviation Police investigate a disembarkation passenger dispute on an EVA Air flight at Taoyuan Airport.
body: Doctor Cheng Cheng-chieh was scratched on the arm by a rushing passenger while disembarking an EVA Air flight at Taoyuan International Airport on August 9, 2026. Cheng later stated on Facebook that he waited nearly half an hour for police officers to board the aircraft.

The Aviation Police Bureau stated on August 10 that officers were responding to another incident involving passengers refusing to board when notified of the dispute. By the time officers arrived at Gate D16 of Terminal 3, passengers had already disembarked. Airline staff subsequently assisted in escorting the involved passengers to the Aviation Police office.

The Aviation Police Bureau contacted Cheng on August 10, and he indicated he did not wish to press charges. Authorities stated they will clarify details and investigate potential violations of the Civil Aviation Act while reviewing operational response protocols.

zh.summary: 美國駐吉布地大使館通報軍機事件；初步回報無人員傷亡或財產損失
body: 美國駐吉布地大使館通報，一架美軍軍機於沙貝利機場（Chabelley Airfield）附近發生事件。大使館表示，初步報告顯示現場並未造成任何人員傷亡或財產損失。
在大使館發布該訊息前，曾發出警示指出正監測吉布地領空內一架遇險航空器，並呼籲民眾避開沙貝利基地的周邊區域。美方人員目前正與吉布地主管機關緊密協調處理相關事宜。
根據 AeroTime 報導，沙貝利機場為美國空軍在非洲最大的遙控無人機基地。報導並指出，已就此事件聯繫位於德國的美國非洲司令部以取得更多資訊。

en.title: US Embassy Reports Incident Involving Military Aircraft Near Chabelley Airfield
en.summary: US Embassy reports military aircraft incident near Chabelley Airfield with no reported casualties or damage.
body: The United States Embassy in Djibouti has reported an incident involving a US military aircraft in the vicinity of Chabelley Airfield. Embassy officials stated that initial reports indicate there were no casualties or property damage resulting from the event.

Prior to issuing the report, the embassy released a security alert stating it was tracking an aircraft in distress within Djiboutian airspace. Members of the public were advised to avoid the area surrounding Chabelley Airfield, while US personnel are coordinating closely with Djiboutian authorities to respond.

According to AeroTime, Chabelley Airfield serves as the US Air Force's largest remotely piloted aircraft base in Africa. The news outlet noted that it has contacted US Africa Command in Germany for additional details regarding the incident.

zh.title: 長榮航BR757班機下機爆旅客衝撞；地勤通報航警處理
zh.summary: 長榮航BR757班機下機發生旅客衝撞；地勤通報航警處理並暫緩下機
body: 長榮航空8月9日由杭州返回桃園的BR757航班在航機停妥等候下機期間，發生一名後排經濟艙旅客急速往前移動並衝撞其他旅客的事件。過程中該名旅客與他人發生口角，並造成同機的婦產科醫師鄭丞傑左手臂遭刮傷。
長榮航空表示，為維護機上旅客及組員安全，當時決定暫緩下機作業，並立即請地勤通報航空警察前來處理。待機上秩序恢復後，航班才繼續進行下機程序。
長榮航空對於事件造成其他旅客下機延誤及不便表達致歉，並指出針對受影響旅客，若有相關權益受損或後續協助需求，將提供必要協助，同時呼籲旅客於航機停妥後應遵循組員指示。

en.title: EVA Air Pauses Disembarkation on BR757 After Passenger Disturbance
en.summary: EVA Air paused disembarkation on flight BR757 in Taoyuan after a passenger disturbance prompted police intervention.
body: EVA Air flight BR757 from Hangzhou to Taoyuan experienced a passenger disturbance on August 9 after the aircraft had parked and passengers were waiting to disembark. According to the airline, an economy class passenger moved rapidly forward from the rear, pushing into other passengers and engaging in verbal altercations. Physician Cheng Chen-chieh was among those struck and suffered a scratched left arm during the incident.

To maintain safety for passengers and crew, EVA Air paused disembarkation and requested ground staff to notify aviation police immediately. Officers arrived on board to address the situation, and disembarkation resumed once cabin order was fully restored.

EVA Air apologized for the delay and inconvenience caused to passengers on board. The airline stated it will offer necessary assistance to affected passengers whose rights were impacted, while reminding travelers to follow crew instructions after arrival.

zh.summary: 達美航空一架波音757-200客機於2026年8月8日自亞特蘭大起飛後，因駕駛艙通報出現煙霧而緊急返回亞特蘭大哈茨菲爾德-傑克遜國際機場。航機降落於滑行道後，機上199名乘客與6名機組人員經由緊急滑梯疏散，其中兩人接受醫療照護。美國聯邦航空總署已就此事件展開調查。
body: 達美航空一架載有199名乘客與6名機組人員的波音757-200客機（註冊號N555NW），於2026年8月8日早上7時35分自亞特蘭大哈茨菲爾德-傑克遜國際機場起飛前往奧蘭多，起飛後不久因駕駛艙通報出現煙霧，決定緊急返航並安全降落。
客機降落於亞特蘭大機場的滑行道後，機上人員透過緊急充氣滑梯進行疏散。據報導，事件造成一名工作人員及一名乘客需要接受醫療照護。達美航空事後已安排乘客改搭另一架航機前往目的地奧蘭多。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）發表聲明證實收到駕駛艙煙霧通報，並表示已對該起改降與疏散事件展開調查。

en.title: Delta Boeing 757 Diverts to Atlanta Over Cockpit Smoke; Passengers Evacuate via Slides
en.summary: A Delta Air Lines Boeing 757-200 diverted back to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport on August 8, 2026, after the flight crew reported smoke in the cockpit shortly after takeoff. The aircraft, carrying 199 passengers and six crew members, landed safely before passengers evacuated onto a taxiway using emergency escape slides. Authorities reported that one staff member and one passenger required medical attention following the evacuation. Delta Air Lines reaccommodated the passengers on another aircraft for their flight to Orlando, while the Federal Aviation Administration confirmed it has launched an investigation into the incident.
body: A Delta Air Lines Boeing 757-200, registered N555NW, diverted back to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport shortly after taking off for Orlando International Airport at 07:35 on August 8, 2026. The return was initiated following reports of fumes or smoke in the flight deck.

Upon returning to Atlanta, the aircraft landed on a taxiway where 199 passengers and six crew members evacuated using emergency slides. A staff member and a passenger required medical attention following the evacuation. Delta Air Lines subsequently arranged a replacement aircraft to transport passengers to Orlando.
The Federal Aviation Administration confirmed in a statement that smoke had been reported in the cockpit and stated that an investigation into the incident is underway.

body: According to media reports published by Simple Flying and AeroTime, a Delta Air Lines Boeing 757 carrying 199 passengers underwent an emergency evacuation on an Atlanta taxiway following an emergency landing. 國泰人壽說明，公司於7月31日會同建築師、承造公司及法律顧問，參與桃園市政府召集的協調會，與建管處、民航局及桃機公司代表釐清法規適用問題與檢討解決方案。會議共識要求此案須依航高限制規定修正高度，現取得核準的建造執照須辦理變更設計。
根據會議共識，民航局將提供座標定位高度供建築師辦理變更設計，承造公司同步向桃機公司提報施工規劃方案，國泰人壽則向桃園市建管單位申請變更設計與施工許可。國泰人壽強調已積極辦理相關程序，並在最短時間內完成拆除作業。

en.title: Cathay Life to Modify Building Height and Demolish Over-Height Structure in Taoyuan
en.summary: Cathay Life Insurance stated that it will modify the height of a building in its Landmark Plaza Taoyuan Zone B commercial development project after reports emerged that the structure exceeded airport conical surface height limits. Following a coordination meeting on July 31 with the Taoyuan City Building Administration Office, Civil Aeronautics Administration, and Taoyuan International Airport Corp., consensus was reached to adjust the building height in compliance with aviation height restrictions. Cathay Life confirmed it will apply for design changes and complete demolition work as quickly as possible under safe conditions to ensure aviation safety.
body: Cathay Life Insurance announced that it will modify the height of a building in its Landmark Plaza Taoyuan Zone B commercial development project after reports indicated the structure exceeded airport height limits. The company stated it will obtain permits and carry out demolition work as quickly as possible under safe conditions to maintain flight safety.

The developer attended a July 31 coordination meeting convened by the Taoyuan City Government with officials from the Civil Aeronautics Administration, Taoyuan International Airport Corp., and local building authorities. Attendees agreed that the building height must be modified in accordance with aviation height restrictions, requiring design changes to the approved construction permit.

The Civil Aeronautics Administration will supply coordinate-based height specifications for design modifications. Cathay Life will apply for design changes and construction permits with local authorities, while the contractor submits a revised construction plan to Taoyuan International Airport Corp. prior to completing demolition.

body: 達美航空一架波音757-200客機（國籍標誌暨登記號碼：N555NW）於2026年8月8日上午07:35自亞特蘭大哈茨菲爾德-傑克遜國際機場起飛，原定飛往奧蘭多國際機場，但在起飛後不久因機組人員獲報駕駛艙出現煙霧，隨即決定返航亞特蘭大。
美國聯邦航空總署表示，該客機安全降落亞特蘭大機場後，機上人員隨即經由緊急逃生滑梯疏散至滑行道上。當時機上共載有199名乘客與6名機組人員。
事故發生後，有一名工作人員與一名乘客需要接受醫療協助，受影響乘客隨後由航空公司安排轉乘其他班機前往目的地。美國聯邦航空總署已證實正對此起事故展開調查。

en.summary: A Delta Air Lines Boeing 757-200 carrying 199 passengers and six crew members was forced to divert back to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport on August 8, 2026, following reports of smoke in the cockpit shortly after takeoff for Orlando. Upon landing, passengers evacuated the aircraft via emergency escape slides onto a taxiway. One staff member and one passenger required medical attention after the incident. The Federal Aviation Administration confirmed that it has launched an investigation into the occurrence.
body: A Delta Air Lines Boeing 757-200, registered as N555NW, diverted back to Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport shortly after departing at 07:35 on August 8, 2026, on a scheduled flight to Orlando International Airport.

According to the Federal Aviation Administration, smoke was reported in the cockpit of the aircraft during flight. Following the landing back at Atlanta, passengers and crew evacuated the airplane using emergency escape slides onto the airport taxiway.

The aircraft was carrying 199 passengers and six crew members. One crew member and one passenger required medical attention following the evacuation. The Federal Aviation Administration stated that it is investigating the incident.

body: 據報導，愛爾蘭新接收的價值5300萬歐元達梭獵鷹6X（Dassault Falcon 6X）政府專機，交付時未裝設FalconEye增強視覺系統。該系統利用攝影機與感測器在惡劣天氣下輔助飛行員。
媒體報導指出該系統由以色列埃爾比特系統製造。愛爾蘭政府於2024年8月實施政策，規定不採購包含以色列製造產品的裝備。愛爾蘭國防部於4月表示，該飛機營運能力目前未受限制。
該飛機由愛爾蘭空軍於巴爾多奈爾凱斯門特飛行場營運，取代舊款Learjet專機。該機型搭載普惠（Pratt & Whitney）PW812D發動機，並於2023年8月獲得EASA與FAA認證。

en.title: Ireland Government Falcon 6X Delivered Without FalconEye System Over Israeli Policy
en.summary: Ireland's new €53 million Dassault Falcon 6X government aircraft has reportedly been delivered without the FalconEye enhanced-vision system. Media reports indicate the equipment was omitted because it is manufactured by Israeli firm Elbit Systems, conflicting with Ireland's August 2024 procurement policy restricting Israeli-manufactured products. The system uses cameras and sensors to assist flight crews during poor visibility, though its absence does not restrict landing capability. The Irish Department of Defence stated in April that the aircraft currently faces no operational limits. The Falcon 6X is operated by the Irish Air Corps from Casement Aerodrome at Baldonnel and replaces an ageing Learjet.
body: Ireland’s new €53 million Dassault Falcon 6X government aircraft was reportedly delivered without the FalconEye enhanced-vision system. The system uses sensors and cameras to assist flight crews during poor visibility, though its absence does not prevent operations in fog.

Media reports stated the equipment was omitted because it is manufactured by Israeli firm Elbit Systems. Under a policy announced in August 2024, Ireland avoids purchasing equipment containing Israeli-manufactured products. The Irish Department of Defence stated in April that there are no operational limits on the aircraft.

The Falcon 6X is operated by the Irish Air Corps from Casement Aerodrome at Baldonnel, replacing an older Learjet. Powered by Pratt & Whitney PW812D engines, the aircraft received certification from EASA and the FAA in August 2023.

zh.title: 美韓展開水下搜尋任務 尋找韓戰失蹤海盜式與C46軍機
zh.summary: 南韓與美國啟動為期一個月的聯合水下搜尋任務，於南韓東海岸的襄陽與江陵外海，尋找1952年韓戰期間失蹤的一架美軍F4U-4海盜式戰鬥機及兩架C-46運輸機殘骸。此次行動由南韓國防部遺骸發掘鑑識團與美國國防部戰俘及失蹤人員統計局合作，投入約40名專業人員與水下探測設備進行搜尋。
body: 南韓與美國已於南韓東海岸外海展開聯合水下搜尋任務，旨在尋找超過70年前於韓戰期間墜毀的三架美軍軍機殘骸。這項為期一個月的搜尋行動將持續至2026年8月28日，重點搜尋區域位於襄陽與江陵外海，目標為1952年在不同事件中墜毀的一架F4U-4海盜式戰鬥機以及兩架Curtiss C-46 Commando運輸機。
本次聯合搜尋行動由南韓國防部遺骸發掘鑑識團（MAKRI）與美國國防部戰俘及失蹤人員統計局（DPAA）共同主持。行動集結了約40名專業人員，包含大韓民國海軍第一艦隊、大韓民國空軍第18戰鬥機聯隊、美國海軍潛水員、水下考古學家以及專業回收搜救小組，期望能藉此釐清未歸官兵的下落。
搜尋任務首先於襄陽外海展開，搜救團隊希望能找到1952年2月執行護航任務時失蹤的一架美國海軍F4U-4海盜式戰鬥機殘骸。該架戰鬥機當時在護航另一架受損的美軍攻擊機時墜毀，導致機上飛行員殉職。搜救人員希望在七十多年後，能夠透過殘骸定位確定其最終墜落位置。
隨後搜尋重點將轉移至江陵外海，尋找1952年下半年相隔不到一個月內相繼失事墜海的兩架C-46運輸機。第一架C-46運輸機於1952年10月16日自江陵起飛前往浦項，在初始爬升階段失控墜入離岸數公里的海中，機上25人全部罹難；第二架同型機則於1952年11月15日執行同一航線起飛後墜海，造成11人死亡、7人倖存。
此次水下調查行動將分兩個階段進行。搜尋團隊將先使用水下探測設備與無人海洋系統對海床進行勘測，以識別可能的殘骸目標。隨後將部署潛水員與遙控感測設備進行現場檢查與記錄，期盼能找出埋藏於數十年沉積物下方的軍機殘骸。

en.title: US and South Korea Launch Underwater Search for Korean War Aircraft Wreckage
en.summary: South Korea and the United States have launched a month-long joint underwater search off South Korea's east coast to locate the wreckage of three US military aircraft lost during the Korean War in 1952. The operation, running through August 28, targets an F4U-4 Corsair fighter off Yangyang and two Curtiss C-46 Commando transport aircraft off Gangneung. Led by South Korea's Ministry of National Defense Agency for KIA Recovery and Identification and the US Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency, the mission involves around 40 personnel using advanced underwater detection equipment, uncrewed systems, and divers across two investigative stages.
body: South Korea and the United States have initiated a joint underwater search off South Korea's east coast to locate the wreckage of three US military aircraft lost during the Korean War more than 70 years ago. The month-long operation, scheduled to run until August 28, is focusing on waters off Yangyang and Gangneung, where an F4U-4 Corsair fighter and two Curtiss C-46 Commando transport aircraft crashed in separate incidents in 1952.

The joint effort brings together South Korea's Ministry of National Defense Agency for KIA Recovery and Identification (MAKRI) and the US Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency (DPAA). Around 40 personnel are participating in the mission, including members of the Republic of Korea Navy's 1st Fleet, the Republic of Korea Air Force's 18th Fighter Wing, US Navy divers, underwater archaeologists, and specialist recovery teams.

The search operation begins off the coast of Yangyang, where investigators aim to locate the remains of a US Navy F4U-4 Corsair that disappeared during an escort mission in February 1952. The aircraft crashed while escorting another damaged US attack aircraft, resulting in the death of its pilot. More than seven decades later, recovery teams hope the seabed search will pinpoint the precise location of the aircraft wreckage.

The focus will subsequently shift to Gangneung, where two Curtiss C-46 Commando transport aircraft crashed into the sea shortly after departure in late 1952. The first C-46 went out of control on October 16, 1952 during its initial climb to Pohang and plunged into the ocean, killing all 25 people on board. Less than a month later, on November 15, 1952, a second C-46 operating the same route crashed after takeoff, leaving 11 occupants dead and seven survivors.

The underwater investigation will be conducted in two sequential stages. Search teams will initially survey the seabed using underwater detection equipment and uncrewed maritime systems to identify potential debris fields. Divers and remotely operated sensing equipment will then be deployed to inspect and document candidate search targets hidden beneath decades of marine sediment.

body: Kratos told The War Zone that a test‑configured Valkyrie was involved in a mishap shortly after taking off from a runway at Dugway Proving Ground on 4 August.

zh.summary: 美國太空軍於2026年8月4日頒發總額6.15億美元合約，資助Rocket Lab與Systems & Technology Research等業者發展天基空中移動目標指示（SB-AMTI）技術。該計畫旨在建立可從軌道追蹤全球軍用飛機的監視網路，其中Rocket Lab獲得3.97億美元合約金額。
body: 美國太空軍於2026年8月4日頒發總額6.15億美元的合約，受資助對象包括Rocket Lab、Systems & Technology Research（STR）以及第三家基於營運安全考量未公開名稱的公司。此項採購旨在推動天基空中移動目標指示（SB-AMTI）技術成熟發展，計畫從軌道對全球空中目標進行追蹤。其中，Rocket Lab證實已獲得3.97億美元，佔本次合約總額的最大份額。
除了最新頒發的合約外，美國太空軍先前已挑選SpaceX負責開發SB-AMTI計畫的初始營運架構，該合約價值最高達41.6億美元。此外，太空軍亦於7月向SpaceX頒發價值16億美元的兩項任務訂單，預計於2027年底前透過18次Falcon 9火箭發射任務將支援衛星送入軌道。

en.title: US Space Force Awards $615M Contracts to Track Military Aircraft from Orbit
en.summary: On August 4, 2026, the U.S. Space Force awarded $615 million in contracts to Rocket Lab, Systems & Technology Research, and an undisclosed third company to mature Space-Based Air Moving Target Indicator (SB-AMTI) technologies. Rocket Lab secured $397 million of the awards, representing the largest portion. The SB-AMTI initiative aims to track airborne targets globally from orbit. Additionally, SpaceX was previously selected under a contract worth up to $4.16 billion to develop the initial operational architecture for the program, along with $1.6 billion in task orders for satellite launches.
body: On August 4, 2026, the U.S. Space Force awarded $615 million in contracts to Rocket Lab, Systems & Technology Research (STR), and an undisclosed third company. The awards aim to mature Space-Based Air Moving Target Indicator (SB-AMTI) technologies, enabling orbital tracking of airborne targets worldwide. Rocket Lab confirmed securing $397 million, which represents the largest share of these contracts.

The awards follow earlier developments in the SB-AMTI initiative, including the selection of SpaceX to develop the program's initial operational architecture under a contract valued at up to $4.16 billion. In July, the Space Force also awarded SpaceX two task orders worth $1.6 billion for 18 Falcon 9 launches to deliver satellites into orbit by the end of 2027.

body: 阿波羅已提出現金收購要約，將易捷航空的已發行及將發行股本估值約為57億英鎊。
根據要約，易捷股東每持有一股可獲取7.15英鎊現金，較Castlelake之前的6.90英鎊報價高出0.25英鎊。
易捷董事會一致推薦阿波羅的現金要約，認為該要約提供即時且確定的價值，同時肯定航空公司的品質與未來前景。
Castlelake宣佈不再對易捷航空提出收購要約，並表示其退出是基於城市收購與合併守則第2.8條，但保留若第三方提出要約時重新進入的技術性權利。

en.title: Apollo Offers £7.15 Per Share for easyJet Takeover
en.summary: Apollo has made a firm cash offer valuing easyJet at approximately £5.7 billion, proposing £7.15 per share, which the easyJet board unanimously recommends; rival bidder Castlelake has withdrawn its offer.
body: Apollo has made a firm cash offer valuing easyJet’s issued and to-be-issued share capital at approximately £5.7 billion.
Under the offer, easyJet shareholders would receive £7.15 in cash for each share they hold, which is 25p above Castlelake’s latest proposal of £6.90 per share.
The easyJet board has unanimously recommended Apollo’s cash offer, describing it as providing immediate and certain value while recognising the quality of the airline and its future prospects.

Castlelake has confirmed it no longer intends to make an offer for easyJet, stating it appreciated the constructive engagement with easyJet’s board and management and thanked them for considering the potential transaction.

en.title: Ex-Flight Attendant Admits Using Fake Pilot ID to Fly Free on Three US Airlines
en.summary: A former flight attendant has admitted to operating a fraudulent scheme that utilized a fake pilot identification to obtain hundreds of free flights across three US airlines, according to reporting by Simple Flying. The individual reportedly used a fictitious employee ID along with insider knowledge of crew operational procedures to slip past verification checks at multiple airport hubs. The scheme allowed unauthorized access to commercial flights using falsified aviation credentials.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying, a former flight attendant has admitted to executing a scheme involving a fake pilot identification to obtain hundreds of free flights across three US airlines.
The individual utilized a fictitious employee ID and leveraged specialized insider knowledge of airline crew procedures to slip past identity verification checks at multiple airport hubs.

By combining the false employee ID credentials with familiar crew protocols, the former flight attendant bypassed security screening checks to travel without authorization across multiple airline hub locations.

The admission details how crew operational knowledge and counterfeit identification were used to circumvent verification procedures at commercial airport hubs across the three impacted US air carriers.
